# Ducky

> Ducky 2.0 is a small, strict Redux store for .NET 10 and Blazor: typed slices of immutable state, pure reducers, one dispatcher that reduces one action at a time, effects with concurrency policies (Merge, Switch, Exhaust, Queue), source-generated registration and dispatch helpers, and Blazor integration (persistence to localStorage, sessionStorage or IDistributedCache, prerender handoff, cross-tab sync, Redux DevTools) that follows the same rules in every render mode. Status: 2.0 preview (`dotnet add package Ducky --prerelease`). License: Apache-2.0.

Every snippet in the guides is a region of a compiled, tested file. Every behavioural rule maps to an invariant (INV-01 to INV-32) with named tests.

- [Step 4: Show state in components](docs/tutorial/04-components.md): DuckyComponent, Select, dispatch
- [Step 5: Load data with an effect](docs/tutorial/05-effects.md): Effect<StoreInitialized>, context.Run, loading and error states
- [Step 6: Search, and effects that overlap](docs/tutorial/06-concurrency.md): Switch, Merge, Exhaust, Queue
- [Step 7: Derived data with a selector](docs/tutorial/07-selectors.md): Selector.Define, memoization
- [Step 8: Keep the basket across reloads](docs/tutorial/08-persistence.md): Persist<T>, versions and migrations, SyncAcrossTabs, the load rule

## Playground

- [Ducky Playground](playground/): Rubber Duck Supply Co., a small shop built only from Ducky (Blazor WebAssembly, in the browser, no server). Live search on a Switch effect, an EntityState catalogue behind memoized selectors, a basket persisted to localStorage with a versioned migration and cross-tab sync, checkout on an Exhaust effect with a declined payment surfaced as EffectFailed, order tracking polled by a Ducky.Reactive pipeline, a profile edited with Ducky.Draft Produce, a MayDispatch veto, a ReducerFailed you can provoke, and a SliceStore. Its X-ray mode names the feature behind each region and shows the app's own compiled source; its inspector logs every action with its DispatchResult.
